title: 「やめて」が言えない女子大生は初めてサレた感触が忘れられずまさかの電車痴●の虜に… 村上悠華
maker: エスワン ナンバーワンスタイル

synopsis: Targeted by a molester, college student Yuka is attacked on her commute and falls into his hands. Unable even to call for help, she lives in daily fear—then a savior extends a hand. This will save her… she thought, but far from being solved, the molestation only escalates. Yet whether the molestation technique caused it or not, a strange feeling like fondness—far from love—had begun to sprout in her heart… 「」●●●●●●
